subject: Renewal & expansion kickoff: Orbit — term changes, throughput uplift, QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kim Alvarez <kim.alvarez@orbitapps.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@orbitapps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Apr 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & expansion kickoff: Orbit — term changes, throughput uplift, QBR scheduling

Hi Kim + Orbit procurement team,

Thanks for the heads-up last week that your contract will come up in June. I wanted to kick off a short renewal & expansion track so we can align on timeline, stakeholders, and decisions needed for a smooth Q3 transition. The goal of this thread is to lock a QBR slot and assign owners so we have a concrete path to sign in June.

Quick context and asks:
- Account: Orbit Apps — current commit through 2028-06-30.
- Customer ask: ~20% average throughput uplift across peak pipelines; exploring dedicated capacity options and a shorter term amendment for new SKUs.
- My ask: confirm the procurement contact + legal reviewer, and provide 3 windows next week for a 60-min QBR.

Proposed 3-week timeline (high-level):
1) This week (Apr 1–5): kickoff, confirm stakeholders, share usage + ask spreadsheet (attached).
2) Week of Apr 8: technical QBR — usage deep-dive, throughput targets, recommended config (dedicated vs shared), and cost model.
3) Week of Apr 15: commercial review & draft SOW circulated; procurement redlines accepted and signatures targeted in June.

Attachments: Orbit_Renewal_ASKS.xlsx (sheet with usage, uplift targets, and proposed SKUs). I’ve looped Ben (Sales) and Aditya (Solutions) to prepare pricing and a short TCO note. Marissa from CS will join the QBR to cover migration/implementation risk.

Please reply with: 1) primary procurement contact, 2) any internal approvers we should include (finance, legal), and 3) three 60-min windows next week you prefer.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: Orbit_Renewal_ASKS.xlsx

Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & expansion kickoff: Orbit — term changes, throughput uplift, QBR scheduling

Hi Monica,

Thanks — this is great. Confirming that Jenna Sutherland (copied) is our procurement lead and will handle contract-level questions. For approvers: Finance (Victor Chan) and Head of Engineering (Ike Ramos) will likely need to be in the commercial review.

Availability for a 60-min QBR next week (all times PT):
- Wed Apr 10, 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Thu Apr 11, 11:00–12:00

We are targeting the throughput uplift for the billing/planning cycles starting July 1; Jenna will follow up on any required PO timelines. Also, could you include a short SOW draft or redlineable doc in the second step? We want to see the exact dedicated SKU options and migration milestones.

On the technical side: we’ll aim to provide a sample of peak trace files by Friday; please tell us the preferred format if different from the CSV in your attach.

-Kim
Kim Alvarez
VP Product Operations | Orbit Apps
kim.alvarez@orbitapps.com | +1 (415) 777-3344
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal & expansion kickoff: Orbit — term changes, throughput uplift, QBR scheduling

Monica / Aditya — thanks for starting this. Quick internal plan from Sales:
- Pricing anchor: present two options at the QBR — (A) 12-month amendment with dedicated pool + 15% unit discount, (B) 24-month term with capacity commit and 22% discount.
- We should pre-compute token-rate delta and projected unit cost for their +20% uplift for both options.
- Aditya: can you prepare a short slide (1–2) on dedicated vs shared tradeoffs (latency, preemption, KV warming) and an estimated monthly cost delta?
- I’ll draft the SOW skeleton; Monica, can you share the usage-runbook-2028Q1.csv to validate traffic profile?

Also adding a practical ask: if Orbit prefers a shorter amendment rather than moving to Dedicated immediately, include a staged path (shared -> burst dedicated -> dedicated) and present automation for cache warming. That pathway usually helps procurement feel comfortable with the spend.

Linking internal playbook and pricing template: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bOrbitRenewal (internal) — use the pricing template in /templates/pricing_anchor.xlsx.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Renewal & expansion kickoff: Orbit — confirmed QBR slot and next steps

Thanks all — locking in Wed Apr 10, 14:00–15:00 PT for the QBR (Google Meet link below). Agenda attached in the SOW draft.

Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/redwood-orbit-qbr
Calendly meeting (for sponsor additions): https://calendly.com/monica-redwood/60min-qbr

Consolidated next steps (owners & target dates):
1) Orbit: send peak trace sample (CSV) — owner: Kim — due Apr 5.
2) Redwood: dedicated vs shared cost delta + 2 pricing options — owner: Ben/Aditya — due Apr 8.
3) Redwood: SOW draft v0.1 (attached) — owner: Ben/Monica — due Apr 12 for internal review; will circulate redlineable PDF to Jenna.
4) Orbit: confirm internal approvers list (Finance/Legal) — owner: Jenna — due Apr 8.
5) Joint: QBR — Wed Apr 10, 14:00–15:00 PT.

Attachments: SOW_Draft_v0.1.pdf; Orbit_Renewal_ASKS.xlsx; usage-runbook-2028Q1.csv
Related: HubSpot deal ORBIT-2028-REN-01, DocuSign placeholder to follow after redlines.

If anyone needs to shift the QBR, please propose alternative windows by EOD Thu Apr 4. Otherwise we’ll assume Wed Apr 10 is confirmed.

Best,
